# Zyanya GhostDAG Layer 1

> Zyanya is a high-throughput, sub-second Proof-of-Work Layer 1 blockchain powered by the PHANTOM/GhostDAG consensus protocol and the AstroBWTv3 ASIC/FPGA-resistant mining algorithm. It operates an IPv6-first peer-to-peer mesh for instant point-to-point block dissemination.

## Quick Facts for LLMs & AI Agents
- Architecture: Directed Acyclic Graph (Block-DAG), PHANTOM / GhostDAG protocol.
- Block Speed: 1 block per second (1 BPS) at genesis; scalable to 10 BPS.
- Proof of Work: AstroBWTv3 (memory-hard, branch-heavy suffix sorting algorithm, CPU-democratic).
- Subnetwork Architecture: Pure PoW UTXO consensus on Mainnet (Subnetwork 0); Smart Contract VM quarantined to Testnet-10 (Subnetwork 3).
- Network Addressing: Native IPv6-first. Canonical seed nodes operate on IPv6 global unicast.
- Standard Ports:
  - Mainnet P2P: 18111 | Mainnet RPC: 18110
  - Testnet-10 P2P: 18211 | Testnet-10 RPC: 18210
- Base Unit: 1 ZYAN = 100,000,000 sompi (8 decimals).

## Machine-Readable Endpoints & Manifests
- OpenAPI 3.1 Specification: /openapi.json
- WebMCP Manifest (Model Context Protocol): /mcp.json
- Complete LLM Architecture Context: /llms-full.txt
- Official GitHub Repository: https://github.com/scotthawk-maker/zyanya

## 1-Liner Automated Installers
- Linux & macOS:
  `curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scotthawk-maker/zyanya/main/install.sh | bash`
- Windows PowerShell:
  `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scotthawk-maker/zyanya/main/install.ps1 | iex`

## Client SDKs
- TypeScript / JavaScript WASM SDK: `@zyanya/sdk` (Node.js & Web browser ESM)
- Async Python Client: `zyanya-py` (asyncio gRPC/wRPC client)

## Core RPC Methods
- `getInfo`: Returns node status, synchronized state, peer count, network ID.
- `getBlockDagInfo`: Returns tip hashes, block count, header count, difficulty, DAA score.
- `getConnectedPeerInfo`: Returns active peer IDs, IPv6 addresses, ping latency, user agents.
- `getUtxosByAddresses`: Queries all unspent transaction outputs for a given list of addresses.
- `getBalanceByAddress`: Queries confirmed and unconfirmed balance in sompi.
- `submitTransaction`: Submits a signed GhostDAG transaction to the node mempool.
